rows.en: ＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿００１Hey, I heard you collapsed...￥Are you okay?
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿００２You push yourself way too hard!＝＠２０５＿００３If you don't take a little more￥care of yourself, training's the￥least of your worries.
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿００４Looks like you've been￥overdoing it for a while...＝＠２０５＿００５I wish I could trade places...
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿００６If there's anything I can do,￥just say the word.
Thanks.
Don't worry about it.
Thanks.
Don't worry about it.
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿００７No need to thank me. You just￥focus on getting better!
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿００８You sure? When you're sick,￥you should take people up on￥their kindness.
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿００９Push it now and it'll only￥get worse.
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０１０So just stay in bed... Though￥all I can really do for you￥right now...＝＠２０５＿０１１is go get you some medicine￥or bring you something to eat.
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０１２Anyway, you'd better rest up￥properly today and get well.
Okay, I will.
I can't just lie here!
Okay, I will.
I can't just lie here!
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０１３Good! Glad you're listening.
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０１４There you go again!＝＠２０５＿０１５If you push yourself while￥you're sick, your training won't￥get you anywhere!
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０１６Now get some sleep!
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０１７You can make up for it once￥you're better.
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０１８See ya. Get some good rest.
